inspection: Seven exact primary repository paths fetched from pinned commits through raw.githubusercontent.com; no source copies saved.

checks.community_provenance: pret/pokediamond README explicitly identifies a Pokemon Diamond decompilation; note treats its Nitro files as community reconstruction, not Nintendo SDK or original JUS authority.
checks.arena_ids_layout: OS_ARENA_MAIN_SUBPRIV=1, OS_ARENA_WRAM_SUB=7, OS_ARENA_WRAM_SUBPRIV=8, OS_ARENA_MAX=9; OSArenaInfo declares lo[9] then hi[9].
checks.address_derivation: HW_MAIN_MEM 0x02000000 + 0x007ffda0 = 0x027ffda0; OSi_GetArenaInfo casts that address; 32-bit pointer slots give lo[id]=0x027ffda0+4*id and hi[id]=0x027ffdc4+4*id.
checks.arm7_signatures: ARM7 header declares void OS_SetArenaHi/Lo(OSArenaId, void*) and void* OS_GetInitArenaHi/Lo(OSArenaId). Note labels these as candidate reconstructed signatures only.
checks.init_order: ARM7 source has separate static OSi_Initialized guard and initializes IDs 1, 7, 8 in high-then-low setter order; each initial-bound getter switches on those IDs.
checks.donor_literal: OS_GetInitArenaLo ID-1 case hardcodes 0x027fafcc with TODO SDK_SUBPRIV_ARENA_LO. Note does not import that value into JUS.
checks.libnds_scope: Pinned devkitPro/libnds include/nds/system.h declares getHeapStart/End/Limit returning u8* under ARM9. It does not establish NitroSDK arena names or slot addresses.
checks.authority_boundary: The note explicitly leaves original JUS names, types, signatures, SDK version, function ownership, original relocation, ABI, extent, execution, and source credit unresolved.

review_scope: External citation and claim audit only; original ROM arithmetic and graph counts assigned to separate reviewer.
